purpose: Losslessly export the three already-frozen Gate-2 M1D checkpoints into a serialization format readable by the pinned ROS Python 3.8/Torch 2.0 runtime.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-5 infrastructure run reading exactly three frozen M1D checkpoints and writing exactly three deployment checkpoints; no dataset frames, training, optimization, checkpoint selection, C10, sensor replay or robot control.
approval.confirmation_reference: User replied '批准' and then '全部都批准' after the exact three-checkpoint inputs, cost, scope and pass/fail evidence were presented; approval is bound only to this immutable deployment-export run.

raw_sources: The approved Gate-2 data cards remain the authoritative training lineage: 80 C01-C08 train worlds, ten C09 checkpoint-selection worlds, 112500 frames in 22500 independent place clusters; C10 and M-TARE reads were zero.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local deployment conversion of already-trained research checkpoints only.

strict_test: All C10 and M-TARE world data are forbidden from this conversion run.

sampling.rule: Read each hash-frozen checkpoint once. Copy every tensor without arithmetic mutation; discard non-portable config objects; do not read any sample, trajectory, model output or world asset.

teacher.source: No teacher or labels are read.
teacher.valid_mask: All 42 parameter names, shapes, dtypes, finite values and byte-level tensor hashes must be identical before/after export and after ROS loading.
teacher.planner_consistency_plan: No graph or planner executes. A fixed synthetic range-image probe must preserve direction-sign, count argmax and role argmax across Torch 2.9 and ROS Torch 2.0 with maximum absolute output error at most 1e-6.

split.historical_pollution_audit: The run reads only the three frozen checkpoint files. It does not reopen their training/validation data and does not read C10 or M-TARE observations.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU only: three Torch-2.9 loads/exports plus three isolated ROS Torch-2.0 loads and fixed-probe forwards; zero GPU and zero training.

evidence.machine_metrics: Three deployment checkpoints, 126 tensor hashes, source/deployment hashes, Torch-2.9 and Torch-2.0 environment identities, six fixed-probe archives, cross-runtime maximum errors, raw log, RUN_STATE and SHA-256 seal.
evidence.complete_visual_review: No image is scientifically useful for a serialization boundary; complete numeric tensor and forward evidence is retained.
evidence.failure_policy: Any source/tool/image drift, overwrite, missing/nonfinite tensor, tensor hash mismatch, output error above 1e-6, decision mismatch or nonzero training/optimizer count is immediate FAIL with no retry or weight change.
